in_marathi.name: Anurag
in_marathi.long_meaning: Anurag हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Anurag is a Sanskrit word meaning 'Love' or 'Passion'. It is derived from the Sanskrit root 'anu' meaning 'with' and 'raga' meaning 'passion' or 'love'. In Hindu mythology, Anurag represents deep and intense emotions and is often associated with the god of love, Kamadeva. Anurag is also a popular name for boys in the Hindu community.
